title: Twin Outposts
lesson: Reconnect separated economies before the joint assault.

objectives.text: Western Command loses its final HQ.
Eastern Command loses its final HQ.
Control the contested central connection for thirty seconds.
Neutralize both hostile production bases after reconnecting.

subtitles.speaker: Joint Command
subtitles.text: Your HQs start on opposite sides of the river. Each commander must keep an HQ alive. Reopen the central connection, then neutralize the command and production structures of both hostile bases. Warned finite detachments enter the northwestern and northeastern roads. Each economy, service slot and army remains owned by its commander.

subtitles.speaker: Operations
subtitles.text: The central connection is open. Refit both forces before the joint assault.
